byLecture.1: Intro to Robotics: transcript, slides, wiki page, 24 images

coverage.note: lecturesTotal is the 9 recorded lectures in the Cairn catalog on 2026-10-20; the course site schedules 24, of which 1-9 had videos and slides. Only lecture 1 (the introduction, no technical derivations) is covered.

figureAudit.note: Six figure-heavy slides of the Lecture 1 deck were checked against the PDF by an independent reader; two small corrections applied. Renders of slides 15 and 32 were also checked.

images.discovery: inline in wiki/ and raw/slides/; no index file
images.note: Lecture 1 only: 24 of its 57 slides, every figure-bearing slide except title and divider slides, an unrendered video frame, news-headline screenshots, a decorative road sign, repeats, and photographs of course staff. No other lecture has images.

caveats: Covers lecture 1 of 9 recorded lectures; it cannot answer questions about the technical content of lectures 2 onward.
Transcripts are copy-edited from YouTube auto-captions; a few passages in lecture 1 were too garbled to restore and are marked [Ed: unclear]. The verbatim captions are not committed.
Lecture 1's deck has no slide 2 (hidden before export): slide N is PDF page N-1 from slide 3 on. Citations use the printed numbers.
